description: On the bed in front of you are several large plastic building blocks: a long blue base piece, a small green block, a small red block, and a larger white block. The left hand stays mostly resting near the blocks while the right hand picks up the green block and presses it onto the blue base, then places the red piece onto the growing stack, and finally lifts and snaps the white block on top to complete a taller multi-colored structure before letting go.
